description: This horizontal stacked bar chart illustrates the results of human evaluations for three evaluated systems. The vertical axis contains the categories, listing the models "Claude3.5", "GPT4o", and "Doubao" from top to bottom, without an explicit overarching axis label. The horizontal value axis features a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, representing proportions, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.2. Each category is represented by a single stacked bar that extends exactly to the 1.0 mark, divided into three horizontal segments that correspond to the legend located at the bottom of the chart. From left to right within each bar, the stacked segments are colored light pink to represent a "Win," light blue to represent a "Tie," and light green to represent a "Lose." Every segment is visually emphasized with an explicit numerical percentage annotation centered within the colored block. For Claude3.5, the composition is 32.0% Win (the shortest Win segment), 44.0% Tie (the longest Tie segment), and 24.0% Lose. For GPT4o, the composition is 56.0% Win (the longest Win segment), 18.0% Tie (the shortest Tie segment), and 26.0% Lose (the longest Lose segment). For Doubao, the composition is 42.0% Win, 36.0% Tie, and 22.0% Lose (the shortest Lose segment). The categories on the vertical axis are not sorted alphabetically or by the descending or ascending value of any specific segment.
